excerpt_i18n.en: In early 2026, after NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang declared "Physical AI is the second inflection point" at CES, World Models became a key battleground for global tech giants. Even before this, many scholars in academia had recognized that AI must understand the common sense of the physical world to truly serve humanity. As influential figures like AI pioneer Fei-Fei Li and former Meta Chief AI Scientist, Turing Award winner Yann LeCun entered the field, it became increasingly clear that this was a more fundamental and challenging domain than large language models. When searching for scholars and companies in this field domestically, Chen Tianrun came into view. Born in 2000, this doctoral student founded Magic Core Technology in 2022. After validating the concept from scratch with a 3D printer, the company fully pivoted to spatial intelligence in 2024. Describing himself modestly as "someone who makes small appliances" or "an entrepreneur from the 3C products industry," this post-2000s founder is not only the CEO of a "multi-billion yuan valued" company in the World Model domain but also a protégé of Academician Pan Yunhe. Recently, Magic Core Technology secured hundreds of millions in funding from giants like Huawei and Lenovo, thanks to breakthroughs in spatial intelligence and World Models. Today, they position themselves as an infrastructure service provider for spatial intelligence. In this conversation, Chen Tianrun discusses technical topics related to spatial intelligence while sharing insights from an entrepreneur's perspective.
excerpt_i18n.es: A principios de 2026, después de que Jensen Huang, CEO de NVIDIA, declarara en el CES que "la IA física es el segundo punto de inflexión", los modelos del mundo se convirtieron en un campo de batalla para los gigantes tecnológicos globales. Sin embargo, mucho antes, muchos académicos ya habían reconocido que la IA debe comprender el sentido común del mundo físico para servir verdaderamente a la humanidad. Con figuras como Fei-Fei Li, la madrina de la IA, y Yann LeCun, ex científico jefe de IA de Meta y ganador del Premio Turing, adentrándose en este campo, se ha ido comprendiendo que se trata de una disciplina más fundamental y desafiante que los grandes modelos de lenguaje. Al buscar académicos en esta área dentro de China.
